FROM ch___company_info

ORDER BY "Credit Rating", "Defaulted"
"""

# Calculate expected distribution (proportions)
total_companies = pivot_df['count'].sum()
pivot_df['expected_proportion'] = pivot_df['count'] / total_companies

# Get all records from ch___company_info
query_all = "SELECT * FROM ch___company_info"
all_records_df = pd.read_sql_query(query_all, conn)

# Calculate divergence score for each record based on its Credit Rating × Defaulted combination
# Score = 1 - (actual proportion of that combination)
divergence_scores = []
for _, record in all_records_df.iterrows():
    credit_rating = record['Credit Rating']
    defaulted = record['Defaulted']
    
    # Find the proportion for this combination
    mask = (pivot_df['Credit Rating'] == credit_rating) & (pivot_df['Defaulted'] == defaulted)
    if mask.any():
        proportion = pivot_df.loc[mask, 'expected_proportion'].values[0]
        # Higher divergence when proportion is lower (rarer combination)
        divergence_score = 1 - proportion
    else:
        divergence_score = 1  # Maximum divergence if combination doesn't exist in pivot
    
    divergence_scores.append(divergence_score)

all_records_df['divergence_score'] = divergence_scores

# Sort by divergence score (highest first) and get top 25
